description.subtitle: Real Betis Hummel Cap - black
description.tagline: Green and white passion with style
description.intro: The Hummel Real Betis Balompié Logo cap is the perfect accessory to wear Betic pride on a daily basis. Made of cotton and with the embroidered shield, it offers comfort and a design faithful to the club's colors.
key_benefits: Identidad verdiblanca: Escudo oficial del Real Betis bordado en el frontal.
Sporty design: Classic and modern aesthetics at the same time.
Comfortable fabric: Soft and breathable cotton.
Adaptive fit: Velcro back strap for a custom fit.
Ideal for everyday use: Perfect for game days, urban use or free time.
